title: Crate Dock
brief: Grid Sokoban: arrow keys move the keeper one cell, push crates onto the three goals, and R restarts the board. In GameState count moves, pushes and crates_on_goal, and set won to true when all three crates are on goals. Walking into a wall or into a crate that cannot move is not a move and not a push.
artDirection: Clean top-down warehouse tiles, warm wooden crates, distinctly marked goal plates, one clearly readable keeper.

obligations.description: Walking into an open cell counts a move.
Shoving a crate counts a push.
A crate pushed onto a goal raises crates_on_goal.
All three crates on goals wins the board.
A move into a wall or an immovable crate leaves moves and pushes unchanged.
obligations.unsupported: The proof vocabulary can prove that a value changed, never that it stayed unchanged; illegal-action rejection needs a negative route and invariance, which the current expect forms cannot express.
